provenance.title: UniTED — labeled time-series event detection
provenance.conference: XIX Brazilian e-Science Workshop (BreSci 2025), co-located with SBBD
provenance.scope: Four complete labeled NAB artificialWithAnomaly source series curated by UniTED, with no point subsampling. ARIMA(2,0,2) and a causal rolling-residual baseline are Python adapters; they are not the original R/Harbinger implementation and do not claim paper-metric equivalence. Detectors fit thresholds on the first 25% and are scored on the remaining observations with point-wise labels; no temporal-tolerance NAB score is claimed. These artificial signals are original benchmark inputs, not locally generated substitutes. Original upstream benchmark: https://github.com/numenta/NAB. UniTED code: MIT; upstream dataset conditions remain applicable.
provenance.executionClaim: Adapted scientific workflow; completion and agreement are reported only by measured evidence.
